propositions: Author a new concurrency-dimension code-review overlay prompt at src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-concurrency.md following the established Pass-1 specialist pattern (frontmatter, concerns, bright-line rule, guards, contract).
The rubric must enforce concurrency-model gating first: name the source (threads, async, multiprocessing, etc.) or declare not-applicable; concurrency that cannot be named is not a finding.

The bright-line finding must cite all four race quartet elements: shared mutable resource (quoted), ≥2 concurrent executors (with spawn/entry point), interleaving window (quoted read and write), and concrete harm (lost update, double-processing, corruption, deadlock).
The lockset check must flag unlocked-twin accessors: new accessors of shared resources that bypass serialization discipline used by sibling accessors, citing the sibling and its guard.
Guard suppression must be disposition-aware: suppress only when guard prevents harm; defer attacker-controlled TOCTOU to security dimension and load-only concurrency to performance dimension by name.

The prompt must instruct criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and state empty findings as expected; frontmatter must match security/performance overlays (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt).
